## 2. Why Choose Jeseem Tours & Travels
- **Four Decades of Trust**: Serving generations of Kerala travelers since 1985 with uncompromised integrity.
- **Direct Airline Series Fares**: Wholesale group airfare blocks and seat allocations guaranteeing lowest airfares for large families, corporate teams, and pilgrim delegations.
- **Transparent Pricing**: 100% upfront quotes with zero hidden charges or last-minute surprise fees.
- **End-to-End Travel Services**: From flight ticketing and luxury hotel accommodations to e-visa processing, embassy attestations, and 24/7 on-trip traveler assistance.
- **Multilingual Support**: Professional consultants fluent in Malayalam, English, Hindi, and Arabic.

## 3. Services Directory

### Flight Ticket Booking Desk
- Group flight ticket reservations for 10 to 100+ passengers.
- Exclusive airline series fares and corporate flight blocks.
- Flights connecting Kochi (COK), Trivandrum (TRV), Calicut (CCJ), Kannur (CNN), and major Indian metros to UAE, GCC, Southeast Asia, Europe, UK, USA, and Canada.
- Instant ticket reissuance, date changes, and baggage allowance upgrades.

### International Holiday Packages
- **Dubai & Abu Dhabi, UAE**: 5 Days / 4 Nights featuring Burj Khalifa VIP observatory, 4x4 desert dune safari with BBQ camp, Dubai Marina luxury yacht cruise, and Abu Dhabi Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque tour. Includes express UAE tourist visa.
- **Maldives Luxury Island Resorts**: 4 Days / 3 Nights featuring private overwater villas, all-inclusive gourmet dining, coral reef snorkeling, romantic candlelight beach dinners, and scenic seaplane or speedboat transfers from Male Airport.
- **Georgia & Caucasus Mountains**: 6 Days / 5 Nights featuring Tbilisi old town, Narikala Fortress, Kazbegi mountain peaks, Stepantsminda, Gergeti Trinity Church, and Kakheti wine cradle region.
- **Malaysia & Langkawi Island**: 6 Days / 5 Nights featuring Kuala Lumpur Petronas Towers, Batu Caves, Genting Highlands cable car, and Langkawi island hopping and skybridge.

### Domestic & Kerala Tourism Packages
- **Kerala Backwaters & Houseboat Cruises**: Private luxury houseboats cruising through Alappuzha (Alleppey) and Kumarakom backwaters with traditional authentic Kerala sadhya and fresh seafood meals.
- **Munnar & Wayanad Hill Stations**: Mist-covered tea plantations, Mattupetty Dam, Eravikulam National Park, waterfalls, and luxury resort stays.
- **Lakshadweep Island Expeditions**: Turquoise lagoons, PADI scuba diving, snorkeling, and entry permit assistance for Agatti and Bangaram islands.

### Visa Assistance Desk
- Tourist and visit visa processing for UAE (30/60-day e-visa), Schengen Countries (France, Germany, Italy, Switzerland), United Kingdom (Standard Visitor Visa), United States (B1/B2 Visa guidance), Canada, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand.
- Complete document preparation, appointment scheduling, and itinerary generation.

### Certificate Attestation & Legalization
- Educational, Personal, and Commercial document attestation.
- State HRD & NORKA Roots verification in Kerala.
- Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) Apostille & Attestation in New Delhi.
- Embassy & Consulate legalizations (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain).

### Sacred Pilgrimage (Hajj & Umrah)
- Customized and group Umrah packages departing from Kerala.
- Verified 4-star and 5-star hotel accommodations within walking distance of Masjid al-Haram in Makkah and Al-Masjid an-Nabawi in Madinah.
- Guided Ziyarat tours with knowledgeable religious coordinators.

## 4. Frequent Questions & Answers (FAQ)

### Q1: What makes Jeseem Tours & Travels the best travel agency in Alappuzha, Kerala?
**Answer**: Founded in 1985 in Thiruvampady, Alappuzha, Jeseem Tours & Travels brings over 40 years of continuous service. It holds premier access to discounted group flight fares, offers personalized international tour packages, fast-track visa processing, certified document attestations, and 24/7 dedicated customer assistance.

### Q2: How do I book flight tickets or inquire about tour packages?
**Answer**: You can contact the reservations team directly at 0477 2266007, WhatsApp +91 9061858416, email reservations@jeseemtours.com, or fill out the booking inquiry form on https://jeseemtours.com/contact.

### Q3: What documents are required for tourist visa processing?
**Answer**: Basic requirements include a passport with at least 6 months validity, recent passport-size photographs with white background, return flight itinerary, proof of accommodation, and bank statements where required. The Jeseem Tours visa desk manages all documentation and filing.

### Q4: Can packages be customized for families or honeymooners?
**Answer**: Yes, all domestic and international packages can be 100% customized based on your preferred travel dates, hotel preferences (3-star, 4-star, 5-star luxury), private vehicle transfers, and specific sightseeing activities.
